title: Ring HUD + Wrist Menu (X) with Settings and Logs
description:
Purpose: Implement diegetic ring HUD and left-wrist menu. HUD shows health, ring charge, willpower focus, reticle/target highlights, objective markers, and construct wheel hints. Wrist Menu (X) provides mission log, settings (comfort, locomotion, audio, visuals), progression/unlocks, ring diagnostics.

Controls (Quest 3 — verbatim):
- X Button: Open wrist menu / mission log / settings panel; Tap to cycle HUD modes if menu is closed.

HUD elements (ring_hud_ui_pack):
- Health arc (left periphery), Ring Charge meter (right), Willpower Focus above right hand, minimal reticle/target highlight, objective tracker.
- High-contrast mode toggle and non-color cues for valid/invalid placement.

Wrist Menu pages:
- Mission Log, Locomotion (provided by locomotion_options_ui), Accessibility & Comfort (provided by accessibility_settings), Audio/Visual settings, Progression & Unlocks (progression module), Ring Diagnostics.

Behaviour:
1) On spawn in central_battery_plaza, show ring hand, activate HUD, and display a prompt toast to open locomotion menu (satisfies test_entry_point_spawn).
2) Anchors HUD elements to hand/head as configured; uses builtin.hud_anchor behaviour internally for stable attachment.
3) Provides registration API for subpages; other modules can register UI controls (locomotion_options_ui, accessibility_settings, mission_system, progression_and_unlocks).
4) Applies settings changes immediately and persists on close.

Components:
- Reads: resource pools from promoted.ring_charge_and_recharge, mission state, accessibility settings.
- Writes: CUIState (HUD on/off, modes), CMenuRegistry, CPersistenceEvents.

Comfort/safety:
- UI opacity adjustable; no forced camera motion; head-locked minimal overlays.

Integration and depends_on:
- Depends on save_persistence for settings persistence.
- Exposes page registration function used by other tasks (locomotion_options_ui, accessibility_settings, mission_system, progression_and_unlocks, aerial_combat_assist).

Assets/scenes:
- Uses ring_hud_ui_pack across all scenes.

Suggested file split: hud_register.cpp, hud_render.cpp, wrist_menu_register.cpp, wrist_menu_pages_api.cpp.
